rules.rule: All refs exact Company and kind; source owners check employee/Employment/period/profile and current state, not only UUID FK.
RESOLVED has each selected singleton once and1..128 selected Employment segments; no candidates; BLOCKED may have partial known refs but no arithmetic.
Segments sorted by effective interval, exact revision/Employment lookup and clipping, no gap/overlap, cover header earning interval with eligible states.

Base wage + correction0 selects original row; positive correction selects same-root exact revision. Selected wage stable through month and pay_date applicability window; amount/hours/profile checks exact.

Eligibility verified for exact basis; arithmetic taxable/pension/status/hours facts match. Tax verified for exact assessment/selection/edition/pay_date and amounts; no circular assessment->tax dependency.

Header population complete under POPULATION/EMPLOYMENT and scope guards, including hidden/blocked members. membership_basis_digest binds canonical selected employee IDs and source query basis defined below.
Source refs max256, candidates max32 perkind; normalized leaf<=64KiB. Over-limit family omitted wholly with explicit blocker; never pretend truncated list complete.
Input membership equals all input units; batch membership equals input units and outcomes exactly; successes biject immutable money rows with matching identities; counts exact.
Close requires nonempty resolved input/current sources; blocked prepare cannot calculate. Kernel blockers create outcome evidence without rewriting input or manufacturing money.
Source-reference rowset is the sole stored slot list; canonical unit basis rebuilt from native columns and this ordered rowset. No second authoritative JSON list.
All ten guards required once/sorted for current NP1 profile; exact current semantic re-resolution may preserve unaffected approval despite unrelated generation advance.
Missing/null, source-slot refs in blockers, candidate/selected duplicates and scalar/date bounds validated before insert; no raw manifest serialized to unauthorized caller.

membership_basis: H(console.payroll.native18.population-basis,{org_id,period,scope_basis_ref,employee_set_digest,selection_contract:"native18-v1"}); employee_set_digest=SHA256(UTF8("console.payroll.native18.employee-set")||0x00||U32BE(count)||sorted unique employee UUID raw16 bytes). Actual population query/source history semantics remain HT1 and source-owner F01/F02; hash never substitutes their proof.
semantic_registry: These closed codes express outcomes, never authority, role, action subtype or transfer reason. An added code requires versioned registered decoder and accessible owner repair projection.
